Fellowship overview

These Göttingen positions support theoretical or computational research in nonequilibrium statistical physics and active matter. The work sits within a research group studying living systems from a physical perspective. Recruitment may continue after the first review date until suitable candidates are appointed.

Research Areas

  • Statistical physics
  • Active matter
  • Applied mathematics

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryTwo-thirds of TVöD Bund E13 salary; cash amount not stated
DurationThree years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationMaster’s degree or equivalent in theoretical physics, applied mathematics or a related discipline.
Further conditionsThree-year contracts; earlier filling can close recruitment.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen until filled
Deadline / consideration round1 December 2026 first review; may accept until 1 April 2027
LocationGermany

About Max Planck Society

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026 TV-L E13 scale (verified): €4,759.37–€6,764.69 gross per month full-time, effective 1 April 2026; part-time positions are pro-rated.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 1 December 2026 first review; may accept until 1 April 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • Studying in Germany: Tuition Fees, Living Costs and Funding

English language requirements

German doctoral employment generally has no fixed IELTS or TOEFL threshold; your English is judged from the written application and the interview, and prior English-medium study is widely accepted as evidence.
